mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_equipment_apply (equipment_id, asset_id, reserve_id, equipment_name, user_id, user_name, apply_type, apply_quantity, apply_time, use_time, return_time, purpose, equipment_status, approval_user_id, approval_status, remarks, return_status, return_apply_time) VALUES (#{equipment_id}, #{asset_id}, #{reserve_id}, #{equipment_name}, #{user_id}, #{user_name}, COALESCE(#{apply_type}, 0), COALESCE(#{apply_quantity}, 1), #{apply_time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{use_time}, #{return_time}, COALESCE(#{purpose}, ''), #{equipment_status}, #{approve_user_id}, COALESCE(#{approve_status}, 0), #{remarks}, COALESCE(#{return_status}, 0), #{return_apply_time,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT ap.*, a.asset_code FROM lab_equipment_apply ap LEFT JOIN lab_equipment_asset a ON ap.asset_id = a.id
SELECT ap.*, a.asset_code FROM lab_equipment_apply ap LEFT JOIN lab_equipment_asset a ON ap.asset_id = a.id WHERE ap.approval_status = 0 ORDER BY ap.id DESC
SELECT ap.*, a.asset_code FROM lab_equipment_apply ap LEFT JOIN lab_equipment_asset a ON ap.asset_id = a.id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND (ap.status IS NULL OR ap.status != 4)
SELECT ap.*, a.asset_code FROM lab_equipment_apply ap LEFT JOIN lab_equipment_asset a ON ap.asset_id = a.id WHERE ap.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_equipment_apply SET status = original_status, original_status = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4
mapper.select: SELECT ap.*, a.asset_code FROM lab_equipment_apply ap LEFT JOIN lab_equipment_asset a ON ap.asset_id = a.id WHERE ap.return_status = 1 ORDER BY ap.return_apply_time DESC
